verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity exposes a documented REST API (verification_sessions endpoint with curl examples), webhooks for outcomes, programmatic access to verification results, and review/blocklist actions — all usable to fully drive the product without a UI. There's also an official MCP server for AI agents to interact with the Stripe API. Missing for 10: a public OpenAPI/swagger spec was probed and returned 404s, and no independent hands-on report of an AI agent driving the API end-to-end.
